title: Describing Research: *módszertanilag*, *szisztematikusan*, *empirikusan*
grammar: Adverbs that say how a study was done
goal: I can say how a study was done with an adverb (*módszertanilag*, *szisztematikusan*, *empirikusan*).
I can name the ideas of research method (*episztemológia*, *falszifikálhatóság*, *ismételhetőség*).
I can write a short sentence that judges how a study was done.

sections.title: Unit 24: Research and Discovery
body: This unit is about how research is done and judged: adverbs for method, chains of steps in a discovery, theory against evidence, the aim of a study, and the size of a discovery.
The unit ends with a text about Szent-Györgyi Albert, who received the Nobel Prize in 1937.
